note: The fuzzer-controlled bytes are written verbatim to a temporary ISO file that becomes the parser input.
The crafted file is parsed into the movie structure, including descriptor lists used later during close.
Closing the parsed movie triggers a write path that walks and frees descriptor state derived from the input.

The code assumes the descriptor list is still valid while iterating it, but the parsed object descriptor can already have transferred ownership of nested lists, violating the lifetime/safety obligation.
Dereferencing the stale list element during descriptor reconstruction leads to a heap-use-after-free read.
